consistency.method: nonlinear derivative array through second time derivative
consistency.interpretation: Every prescribed dynamic coordinate is held fixed in scaled coordinates. The original residual uses the time tolerance; differentiated residuals use tangent row scaling. Algebraic state and physical dynamic rates pass local uniqueness, one-sided and spacing-refinement checks. Auxiliary higher derivatives need not be unique. Finite differences give local numerical evidence, not a proof for arbitrary higher-index or nonsmooth systems.

! Original OpenSwing harmonic verification example. SI input units.
! Fixed root, axial stiffness k=500 N/m, tip mass m=2 kg, damping time .02 s.
! Engine setting is a force in N along +y. Set gravity to zero, alpha=0.
! Tip y response per unit setting: 1 / [500*(1+i*.02*omega)-2*omega^2].
Name
Instrumented spring-mass demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 2 0 2 0 19.6133
End
Engine
1 0 1 2 0 2 0 0 1 0 1 0 -1 0 0
End
Beam 1
Axial spring
t y EA tdeps Cshell Nshell Atshell
0 0 1000 .02 .1 .1 .001
2 2 1000 .02 .1 .1 .001
End

! Default body-aligned pylon-tip pitot, accelerometer and GPS.
Sensor
1 1 0 0 0 .2
2 1 2 .3 2 .2
End

Full airflow includes the implemented regularized lifting-line, volume, propulsive jet and gust fields. Near-filament/core and ASWING sensor-flow parity require independent refinement.

Structural force/moment use the inward endpoint trace and left trace at an interior anchor, in the anchor csn frame. Both adjacent traces are exported; exact ASWING trace choice at load/property jumps is unverified.
Mechanical strain and shell stress use the selected adjacent element material midpoint, whose location is reported. They are not exact nodal or pylon-tip strain measurements.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.
Selected measurements can drive scheduled feedback and differential error integrals. Full control-file index/unit mapping and arbitrary custom controller parity remain unverified.

forcing.after_end: zero applied specified value (also for + channels); final sample uses its table value
limitations: ASWING spline endpoint conditions are unverified; natural cubic segments are used.
Zero-after-end applies to complete specified values; relative-channel cutoff still needs an ASWING executable comparison.
Measurement histories act as commands only when selected by the active controller. Inverse operating histories remain pending.
Experimental time solver; ASWING executable/discrete parity is unverified.

Cold trajectories start at zero local rates. Saved-equilibrium launches can complete compatible physical disturbances with nonlinear constraint checks. Checkpoint continuation retains elastic velocities, circulation, frame motion, controller states and BDF history.

Flap/engine, prescribed acceleration and active net-force/moment target tables are supported with mixed frame constraints. Specified values become zero after the last table time, including relative channels. Earth gusts and selected controller commands participate in the implicit solve; remaining inverse histories and companion-file parity are pending.
The time step controls resolution. Halving after nonlinear failure does not estimate temporal error.

Radau IIA has fifth-order ODE accuracy; constrained velocities and reactions can converge at lower order. BDF startup can produce nonconvergent peak reaction transients for curved constraints with nonzero initial velocity; use Radau and check temporal refinement for those motions.
Prescribed atmospheric altitude and ambient-relative frame motion; atmospheric variation with trajectory is pending.
